Genes described in the differentiation of monocytes into moDCs

Código: R/moDC_genes.R
moDC_genes.Rd

Curated list of genes reported in the literature as up- or down-regulated when monocytes differentiate in vitro into monocyte-derived dendritic cells (moDCs), grouped by biological process. Used to check the expected transcriptional changes (Figure 4C of the article).

Uso

moDC_genes

Formato

A data frame with 90 rows and 7 columns:

gene

Gene symbol.

Gene_name

Name used in the source publication (e.g., "IL-1beta").

process

Biological process (e.g., "Maturation", "Cytokines").

Associated_pathways

Pathway or description reported in the source.

Expression

Reported direction: Upregulated or Downregulated.

link

Link to the source publication.

contrast

Comparison in which the change was reported.

Fuente

See the link column.

Detalles

The script that generates it is data-raw/lesson5_data.R. Text was converted to ASCII (Greek letters spelled out) and the spreadsheet artifact "GBP 2.00" was corrected to "GBP2". Eleven entries use aliases or old names (CD31, CD54, IL8, IRF7A, ERF2, CD32, TNFR2, IP3KB, HSP27, GRP78) or genes absent from the data (CXCL8); they do not match the gene symbols of filtered_txi and, as in the original analysis, are not shown.
